instagram.body:
AI is starting to challenge one of the biggest assumptions in the software industry that once a SaaS company becomes large enough, its position is secure. 

As AI tools become better at writing code, automating workflows, and building software faster, many traditional software advantages are becoming weaker.

According to Dario Amodei, the old SaaS moat of “complex software” is disappearing as AI makes building products faster and cheaper. 

He believes companies that recognize this shift early and aggressively rebuild around AI could become much stronger.

Follow (@entrepreneursonig) for everything related to entrepreneurs.

Media: CNBC
I think individual SaaS companies, it's very possible for them to lose market value, go bankrupt, completely go bust. But but it it it it it depends on on the response, right? And with AI with how fast everything is moving, these huge companies are integrating things at such a fast pace, AB testing at such a large scale. Um so we're building a new app for the affiliate program and reskinning our entire website to be a new to be a new look and feel for our brand.
